facts.text: A dedicated off-road rule requiring an ML-based collision-avoidance function to meet a specified ML validation standard by 2028 was not found for the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, South Africa, Brazil, Chile, Peru, India, Japan or China.
facts.quote: a dedicated off-road rule stating that an ML-based collision-avoidance function must meet a specified ML validation standard by 2028 was **not found**.

facts.text: The absence finding for ML-based off-road collision-avoidance rules in the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, South Africa, Brazil, Chile, Peru, India, Japan and China does not establish that those jurisdictions have no AI legislation; no AI legislation bearing on this function was found.
facts.quote: This does not mean no AI legislation exists in those places; it means none was found that bears on this function.

facts.text: Existing machinery, mine, workplace and functional-safety obligations continue to apply to ML-based off-road collision-avoidance functions even when the algorithm is learned.
facts.quote: Existing machinery, mine, workplace and functional-safety obligations do not disappear because the algorithm is learned.
